# One class per line (javap -p). "Class :: regex" keeps only matching members (constructors always kept).
# "grep <regex>" lists the class names matching the regex.
# Round 4: what changed between 1.21.11 and 26.1 / 26.2 / 26.3

grep GuiMessageTag\.class
grep ^com/mojang/blaze3d/pipeline/[A-Za-z$]*\.class
